title: Divergence theorem on a C² submanifold for compactly supported fields (Simon 4.22(*), 4.29-4.30)
statement: Assume (TH). (TH) is the frozen statement of the sibling root.submanifold_tangent-a1, taken as an explicit hypothesis: (TH1) for every Simon local representation (V, W, ψ) of class r ≥ 1 of any M ⊆ ℝᴺ, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = range Dψ(x) for x ∈ V; (TH2) every n-dimensional C^r Simon submanifold of ℝᴺ is a measurable set on which y ↦ tangentProjection M y is continuous. Let M ⊆ ℝᴺ be an n-dimensional C² Simon submanifold, Y : ℝᴺ → ℝᴺ of class C¹, and S ⊆ ℝᴺ closed with Y(x) = 0 for x ∉ S and M ∩ S compact. Then y ↦ tangentialDivergence M Y y and y ↦ ⟨Y(y), meanCurvature M y⟩ are integrable on M with respect to μHE[n], and ∫_M tangentialDivergence M Y dμHE[n] = −∫_M ⟨Y, meanCurvature M⟩ dμHE[n].
lean_statement: ((∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), 1 ≤ r → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) ∧ ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → MeasurableSet M ∧ ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M) → ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M S : Set (Rn N)) (Y : Rn N → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) 2 M → ContDiff ℝ 1 Y → IsClosed S → (∀ x ∉ S, Y x = 0) → IsCompact (M ∩ S) → IntegrableOn (tangentialDivergence M Y) M μHE[n] ∧ IntegrableOn (fun y ↦ inner ℝ (Y y) (meanCurvature M y)) M μHE[n] ∧ ∫ y in M, tangentialDivergence M Y y ∂μHE[n] = -∫ y in M, inner ℝ (Y y) (meanCurvature M y) ∂μHE[n]
